term: Critical Batch Size and Gradient Noise Scale
category: Advanced Training, Adaptation, and Model Surgery
definition: The batch size beyond which adding data parallelism stops buying training speed, predicted by the gradient noise scale (how noisy gradients are relative to their mean).
details: The batch size beyond which adding data parallelism stops buying training speed, predicted by the gradient noise scale (how noisy gradients are relative to their mean). The quantitative tool labs use to decide how many GPUs a run can actually use efficiently.
